newsitem.title: USA: Texas Biotechnology stake raised by investor.
newsitem.headline: Texas Biotechnology stake raised by investor.

text.p: Larry Feinberg, a New York investor, said on Tuesday he raised his stake in Texas Biotechnology Corp to 2,648,324 common or 10.95 percent from 9.20 percent held previously.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Feinberg said his latest transactions included the purchase of 249,500 common shares from Oct 17 to Oct 23 at prices ranging from $3.9375 to $4.45 per share.
Feinberg is the managing general partner of Oracle Partners L.P. and president of Oracle Investment Management Inc.
